title: Charge and battery runtime
passage:
The display shows the battery at eighty percent. Can I tell customers it will run for most of the day?
A. That’s how much charge it has now. How long it lasts depends on what they’re running.
B. This model came with a smaller charger last year.
C. The display is set to turn off when it isn’t being used.
passageZh:
顯示畫面顯示電池還有百分之八十的電，可以跟客戶說它能運作大半天嗎？
A. 那是它現在的電量。能撐多久，取決於他們在執行什麼。
B. 去年這個型號附的是比較小的充電器。
C. 螢幕設定成沒在使用時會關閉。
